scene: The horn blast opens three departure chutes along the tower platform.
picture: Flat side-view along the open departure platform. Far left, a wooden river barge rests at a low slipway. Left, the woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands holding the satchel. Centre, a glass-roofed trolley sits behind an open gate. Far right, an orange mountain cable tram dangles from its overhead wire.
shown: A flat wooden river barge docked at an open slipway, far left
A rounded glass-roofed trolley waiting inside an open iron gate, centre
A hanging mountain cable tram swaying on a thick wire, far right
